meaning: Whatever operates from itself and is moved in no respect lives at some time, through the timed predicate OperatesFromItselfAt: the self-operation is present at some time (OPEN), and operating from itself at a time is living at it (OPEN q.18 a.2 reading). The unmoved clause of the conclusion is not used: under these two premises every self-operating thing lives, which is a strictly stronger conclusion.
